authors.bio: Pete Putman is the president of ROAM Consulting LLC, Doylestown, PA. He is a 44-year veteran of the commercial AV, display, and home theater industries. He has authorized hundreds of columns, tutorials, and feature articles on topics as diverse as display technology, digital video, RF, wireless signal propagation, and display signal interfacing, all for a wide range of magazines and media outlets.
